zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Paramus Borough Center, Residential & Parkway Districts
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 1.954%, with an equalization ratio of 84.2%.
Public education represents 56.4% of property taxes, while municipal operations account for 32.8%.
Average residential assessment is $623,080, producing an average annual tax bill of $12,175.0.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Paramus Borough, homeowners pay an average of $12,175.0 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 8.54% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 84.2%, assessed values average ~84.2% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 56.4% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 32.8%, and Bergen County claims 10.8%.
